sponsors.name: Sahyadri Sports Foundation
sponsors.tagline: Grassroots grants for Pune's college athletes
sponsors.about: A Pune-based sports foundation that funds travel, coaching and tournament fees for first-generation athletes. Every grant is reviewed by a panel of coaches and former athletes, with priority for athletes who have no other institutional support.

sponsors.name: Deccan Track Club
sponsors.tagline: Track and field scholarships with year-round coaching
sponsors.about: A Deccan Gymkhana club that has supported Pune runners for more than two decades. Its athlete programme combines a monthly coaching stipend with access to the club's track, physio room and weekend race calendar.

sponsors.name: Balewadi Performance Lab
sponsors.tagline: High-performance training partnerships for serious athletes
sponsors.about: A performance centre next to the Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex. It offers selected college athletes structured strength and conditioning, recovery sessions and sport-science testing alongside their regular coaching.

sponsors.name: BharatShield Gear
sponsors.tagline: Kit and apparel sponsorships for college teams
sponsors.about: A Pune sports equipment brand that outfits college teams with match kit, training apparel and footwear. Sponsorships are awarded per season and include a gear allowance the athlete can spend on the brand's catalogue.

sponsors.name: Kalyani Mobility
sponsors.tagline: Travel support for teams competing outside Pune
sponsors.about: A mobility company that helps college teams travel to district, state and national competitions. Support covers transport, fuel and a share of tournament entry fees for squads that qualify out of Pune.

sponsors.name: Pune Collegiate Sports Trust
sponsors.tagline: Scholarships that keep college athletes in the game
sponsors.about: A trust set up by Pune college alumni to stop talented athletes from dropping out for financial reasons. It funds tuition-linked sports scholarships, facility access and coaching for athletes across the city's colleges.
